scientific_integrity: All proofs refer to the ordinary Chari–Joswig Morse matching complex. The infinite-order formulas are proved symbolically; exact finite checks are supplementary, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the full graded rational chain character and the reduced homological alternating trace; it does not reconstruct homology representations degree by degree on arbitrary graphs.
The Knudson–Owens-White 2026 first version was verified through public metadata and abstract but its full text was inaccessible; its focus is strong rather than ordinary matchings.
An indexed-literature search cannot exclude unknown unindexed equivalent orbit-forest character formulations.
title: Equivariant matrix–forest character formula for graph Morse complexes
